snippet.title: Evidentia | Official Trailer | Co-op Detective Card Game
snippet.description:
A detective card game where every deck is a new case. Solo or with up to 4 friends.

🔎 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4426390/Evidentia?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=social_media

Evidentia is a co-op detective card game from VSI Games, an indie studio from Ukraine. You play as an investigator: collect evidence, connect the facts and uncover the truth. Every deck is a self-contained mystery with its own backstory, suspects and ending.

Play at your own pace in solo mode, or gather a lobby of up to 4 players and crack the case together. While your friends are joining, you read the case files and sink into the story. A short tutorial gets new players in without friction.

Genre: detective card game
Players: 1-4, solo or online co-op
Platform: PC (Steam)
Release: Fall 2026

We build Evidentia in the open and post a devlog about the whole process, from raw prototypes to release. Subscribe if you want to see how an indie game
actually gets made.

Which case would you want to investigate first? Tell us in the comments 👇

= = = = =

Детективна карткова гра, де кожна колода це окрема справа. Грай соло або з друзями, до 4 гравців.

Evidentia це карткова детективна гра від української інді студії VSI Games. Ти береш на себе роль слідчого: збираєш докази, зіставляєш факти і розкриваєш справу. Кожна колода це самостійна історія зі своєю таємницею, підозрюваними і фіналом.

Ми створюємо гру відкрито і ведемо devlog, де показуємо розробку крок за кроком, з багами, прототипами і всім як є. 

Підписуйся, Дружбанчики, далі буде цікаво.

🔗 TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@vsi_games
